name: Live TV (M3U)
description: Your own IPTV channels from M3U playlists (up to 5), with their programme guides from XMLTV.

listing.summary: Watch the channels of your M3U playlists (IPTV subscriptions, public lists) with a programme guide.
listing.description: Paste the address of an M3U playlist in its settings, and optionally of an XMLTV guide (else the one the playlist names); up to 5 playlists, their channels shown together. The channels show in a Live TV section with their programmes; the server plays HLS and MPEG-TS streams. The plugin carries no list of its own.
listing.disclaimer: Only add playlists you are allowed to watch. Playpex is an educational project.
